models_evaluated: ensemble machine learning pipeline of general and fluid-specific models with SHAP explanations

links.outcome: Sensitivity, specificity and MCC on internal versus external validation sets
links.effect: Internal: sensitivity 0.858, specificity 0.993, MCC 0.747. External: sensitivity 1.00, specificity 0.980, MCC 0.387. Sensitivity was maintained but MCC fell at the external site.
links.quote: The sensitivities, specificities, and Matthews correlation coefficients were 0.858, 0.993, and 0.747 for the internal validation set, and 1.00, 0.980, and 0.387 for the external set.

unlisted_practices: Ensemble ML detection of IV fluid contamination in laboratory results

screen.reason: Evaluates an ensemble machine learning pipeline for detecting IV fluid contamination in basic metabolic panels using internal/external validation and subgroup fairness analysis, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
